svg.text: What is bought predicts competition better than who buys it
Among awards their own department labelled competed, the single-bid rate runs from 14.6% to 64.8% across product families — and neither the buying department nor the contract vehicle accounts for it.

Facility operation has 335 distinct parent suppliers across 1,781 awards and draws one bid 26.4% of the time; medical and laboratory equipment has 10,088 across 146,765 and draws one
77.0% of the time. Across the 29 families the correlation between how concentrated the suppliers are and how often one bid arrives is slightly negative, so the crowded markets are the
quiet ones. Whatever decides this, it is a property of the thing being bought rather than of the number of firms able to sell it — and that is the variable an oversight screen would most
USAspending API v2 bulk download, fetched 2026-09-22; FY2016. Rates use the awards carrying a competed label and a usable bid count. CAVEAT: across ALL awards vehicle orders are 60.0%
single-bid and everything else 59.6% -- uncompeted awards are 99%+ single-bid whatever the procedure and swamp that comparison. These eleven civilian departments are 8.5% of federal
contract awards; Defense (68.6%) is absent, so this is not federal procurement as a whole.
